name: Danielle Frankel
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $2140 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Made-to-order bridal gowns (prices on request), veils, headpieces and bridal shoes, sold through its New York and Los Angeles ateliers, bridal shops and its site.
origin: Founded in 2017 by Danielle Frankel Hirsch.

quote.q: I design for a very independent woman who really cares about the craftsmanship of her clothes

opview: “I design for a very independent woman who really cares about the craftsmanship of her clothes” — Danielle Frankel Hirsch, founder, The Zoe Report

facts_read.source: brand site; The Zoe Report 2021-05-31; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: US: 2 own doors, both bridal salons by appointment — the 'New York Atelier', 260 West 39th St, 14th floor, NY 10018, and the 'Los Angeles Boutique', 8475 Melrose Place, CA 90069. Counted because the brand publishes the addresses and books retail appointments at both; flag if appointment-only salons should be excluded. New York bridal label.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 8 product types, proportional; 275 styles from 388 records in /collections/all/products.json; veils, jewellery, shoes, alteration

craft_evidence.owned: claim with a place — PDPs say each gown is 'made to order in the Garment District of New York City' and refer to 'the Danielle Frankel New York Atelier'; no address, photograph or filing found
craft_evidence.makers: no (the atelier is the brand's own; no outside maker named)
craft_evidence.mills: no — fabrics named by type (silk wool, Lyon lace, silk organza), no mill
craft_evidence.madein: 52% (41 of 79 sampled carry 'Made in: Garment District, New York City'; the rest have no spec table)
craft_evidence.heritage: not found on the pages read beyond the designer's name
craft_evidence.process: partial — PDPs describe hand work specifically (hand-cut and hand-applied silk wool petals, hand-painted silk wool, hand-frayed bias strips) and give lead times (24 weeks, made to order)
craft_evidence.reasoning: About half the product pages state each piece is made to order in New York's Garment District at the brand's own atelier, with specific hand processes and lead times. The atelier is claimed, not shown with an address or photo, and no mills are named. Place-specific own making with documented hand work is a 3; a shown atelier would argue for 4.
